_comment: THE MANAGER'S ONE REGISTER. Adopted 2026-09-21 (operator-directed operating reset).
Scope of record: docs/plans/OPERATING-PLAN-2026-09-21.md. Manager contract: .claude/skills/manager/SKILL.md.
The previous 323-row file is preserved verbatim at
RULES FOR THIS FILE, because the last one grew 67 top-level keys and 323 rows:
1. items[] is the content. Top-level keys are schema only - no narrative,
no timestamped manager_observation_* / manager_tick_* entries, no incident logs.
Three observations an hour apart on one row is the failure mode, not diligence.
2. ONE status field: `state`, from the `states` vocabulary below. There is no `status`.
3. `done` and `landed_unproven` are DIFFERENT FACTS and are never collapsed.
4. A row that is neither a plan item nor a live lane does not belong here.
A question goes to research/queue/<id>.yaml instead.
5. This file is served to the operator as the live Workflow page via
GET /api/bot/work/checklist, read from the VM's working tree. ict-git-sync
pulls main every ~5 min, so the page is as fresh as the last push TO MAIN.
cycle_intent: Make the promotion ladder mechanical and the research loop terminate in a decision. Edge is decided offline; a book only ever checks mechanics and cost.

states.queued: scoped and agreed, nobody started it
states.in_flight: a lane is actively working it
states.blocked: waiting on the thing named in blocked_on
states.dropped: deliberately not doing; note says why

item_schema.id: plan item id (A1..D3) or a lane id
item_schema.title: one line
item_schema.lane: session id once dispatched, else null
item_schema.model: the model chosen for the lane, with the reason in `note`
item_schema.ceiling_usd: per-lane dollar ceiling; on breach READ what it produced, then kill or re-scope
item_schema.spend_usd: actual, filled in by the cost meter (A1)
item_schema.tier: 1 | 2 | 3 - the approval the resulting change needs
item_schema.note: what is true about this row. Not a log.

items.title: Cost meter — cost and tokens per session into one register, rendered in the brief
items.note: Per-lane ceiling + a daily total. Today 263 session rows across ~90 keys carry ZERO cost or token fields. The meter's job is scoping, not accounting.

items.title: Cut CLAUDE.md to ~15K tokens
items.note: DONE in this PR: 547 KB -> 16.5 KB (~136K -> ~4.1K tokens). The generated SESSION-BRIEF block (39.4% of the file) and its generator scripts/ops/render_session_brief.py are deleted. Reference moved verbatim to docs/reference/. landed_unproven until a cold session is observed orienting from the cut file.

items.title: Daily brief generator — four fixed sections, pushed before the sync
items.note: Renders from research/queue/ + checklist lane state + the A1 cost meter. Served on the existing Workflow page. Blocked on A1 for section 4 only; sections 1-3 can ship first.

items.title: Manager contract — one page replacing ~6,200 lines of process skills
items.note: DONE in this PR: .claude/skills/manager/SKILL.md. One job, one register, spawn rules, model table, budget, brief format. landed_unproven until a manager session is observed running against it.

items.title: Stand down the governance layer
items.note: DONE in this PR: archived the work store (210 objects), OPEN-ITEMS.json, the four review backlogs (951 open rows), SESSIONS.json, MANAGER-LEASE.json, MERGE-QUEUE.json, DUE.*, READOUT.md, the coordination board and 10 process skills. REMAINING for a build lane: retire the guards and crons that guarded the archived machinery, and prune the workflow catalog.

items.title: Pull the two negative-OOS legs off alpaca_live
items.note: tlt_pullback_1h (-4.41R, n=94) and tlt_pullback_1d (-3.92R, n=8, 0 of 4 folds positive). One-line config change, reversible, does NOT wait on D1. TIER-3: needs explicit operator approval before merge.

items.title: Invert the execution-gate guard — evidence required to reach a Stage-2 roster
items.note: THE LOAD-BEARING CHANGE. Today check_dry_run_in_diff.py blocks turning a leg OFF and nothing blocks turning one ON; across 78 guards there is no counterpart. Demotion becomes free; promotion to a real-money roster requires a fresh evidence record clearing its declared bar. Tier-2 (CI + order-path policy) and needs the operator on the bar definition.

items.title: Alpaca mirror invariant
items.note: Extend tests/test_paper_portfolio_accounts.py's Bybit roster-sync test to alpaca_live / alpaca_portfolio. Measured 2026-09-21: alpaca_live 5 strategies, alpaca_portfolio 14 - so that mirror cannot be read as the honest-size live book and Gate 2's demotion signal does not work on that side.

items.title: R4 as the DEMOTION gate
items.note: Flip to enforcing, pointed at demotion rather than promotion. A mirror carrying an identical roster only holds data for legs already live, so it cannot gate entry - it gates exit. Recommended 2026-07-30, built, shipped observe-only, never armed. Tier-2.

items.title: Re-scope the review packet — Stage 2 on money, Stage 1 on cost fidelity
items.note: Without this it keeps grading 52 legs against a 20-trade floor and emitting nothing, forever. comms/strategy_reviews/2026-09-20/INDEX.json: 52 graded, 71 closes in window, actionable 0, its own days_to_grade_all_reachable_point 140.0, unbounded_no_closes 23.

items.title: decision_rule in the research queue schema, plus a guard that refuses a unit without one
items.note: Decide before you measure: the result IS the decision, removing the interpretation step where everything currently dies (1 actioned disposition of 117).

items.title: Make the 19 artifact-only research workflows commit to a corpus
items.note: 19 of 23 produce an artifact and an issue comment and nothing else. A result nobody can query later is not evidence.

items.title: Let replay-pregate land
items.note: runtime_logs/** is not in TIER1_SURFACE so pr-landing-guard R5 rejects the commit - 0 reports on main since inception. Separately the trainer swap-thrashes, so 6 of 6 nightly runs die at 10 of 22 heads and no non-BTC head has ever been graded.

items.title: Wire the 9 orphan backtest harnesses; replace the smoke fixture
items.note: 9 of 13 harnesses are wired to no workflow, and the default candle file is a 5,001-row smoke fixture spanning 3.5 days of 2022.

items.title: Write the first ten pre-registered research questions
items.note: The only item in this plan that builds nothing - and the only one that produces knowledge. Each carries hypothesis / population / instrument / decision_rule / cost / tier.

items.title: Flip the backtest cost defaults on, and re-run the corpus
items.note: src/runtime/execution_costs.py models fee + slippage + funding correctly; the HARNESSES set SLIPPAGE_BPS_ROUNDTRIP and FUNDING_BPS_PER_WINDOW to 0.0 by default, deliberately, for backward compatibility. So every 'passed the backtest' verdict in the corpus is fee-only and optimistic by an unknown amount - measured once at +0.57R on htf_pullback_trend_2h, the one leg anyone checked. 6 of 13 harnesses have no cost terms at all, including the vwap harness (vwap is 318 of 431 lifetime real-money trades).

items.title: Cut Stage 2 to what actually passes
items.note: Depends on D1: until the re-run we do not know which legs clear Stage 0. Today 3 of 44 meet the live_money_ready bar and none is on bybit_2. Tier-3.

items.title: Cost-fidelity job — weekly realized-vs-modelled cost per Stage-1 leg
items.note: This IS Gate 1, and it is what makes the ladder traversable for slow legs: 'is realized slippage what we assumed?' converges in a handful of trades where expectancy needs 50+. Build only once D1 has given it something to compare to.
